canonical_ownership_rules: One canonical molar reaction progress R_k [mol/(m^3 s)] per reaction.
Every heavy-species, electron-particle and electron-energy consumer reuses the same R_k; no downstream kinetic reevaluation.
Lookup-table electron-impact rates reuse PhysicsElectronImpactRateMaterial unless a demonstrated capability gap requires another owner.
Heavy-species signed mass-source functors are projected through the existing PhysicsFVSpeciesReactionSource or an independently validated Standard-MOOSE equivalent.
Signed physical electron-number sources are projected through the existing PhysicsFVElectronReactionSource or an independently validated Standard-MOOSE equivalent.
Electron-energy loss uses Standard-MOOSE FVCoupledForce where the source is representable by a progress functor and coefficient.
Molar masses and concentrations must reuse the canonical heavy-mixture species state rather than introduce a second composition basis.
Missing source data is a hard admission block; no synthetic rate is allowed in production.
